public_data_only.details: EPA TRI Basic Plus Data Files are publicly downloadable without authentication from https://www.epa.gov/toxics-release-inventory-tri-program/tri-basic-plus-data-files-calendar-years-1987-present. No login, no API key, no paid access required. Data is in the public domain under federal open data policy.

no_pii.details: Dataset contains only facility-level business information: company names, facility business addresses, NAICS codes, parent company names, chemical release quantities, and EPA facility IDs. No personal names, personal home addresses, personal emails, personal phone numbers, or financial account numbers present. The validation flagged 23 'phone number' detections in the facility_name column — these are FALSE POSITIVES. Sample: 'SHELLY MATERIALS PLANT NO 94 (0145000399)'. The parenthetical numbers are EPA-issued TRI facility identifiers (10-digit codes), not phone numbers. Facility business addresses are acceptable for industrial/commercial entities with public TRI reporting obligations.

source_url_on_every_row.details: All 78,647 rows have a populated source_url field pointing to the EPA Envirofacts TRI detail page for each facility-chemical-year combination. 100% completeness confirmed by validation. Sample URL format: https://enviro.epa.gov/enviro/ef_metadata_html.tri_page?p_year=2023&p_tri_id=01507NCMNCRT169

production_ready.details: Clean, validated dataset with no placeholders, no mocks, no half-built features. All key fields (facility name, address, chemical, release quantities, source URL) fully populated. Parent company field has 21.39% null rate (expected for facilities without parent companies or self-reported as independent). 965 key duplicates (1.23%) represent facilities reporting the same chemical in multiple quarters within the same year — acceptable for a regulatory reporting dataset.

ethical_considerations.details: EPA TRI data serves the public interest under the Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act (EPCRA). Congress mandated public disclosure of industrial chemical releases to empower community awareness and informed decision-making. Selling cleaned/packaged TRI data supports environmental transparency, compliance, and ESG accountability. No individual privacy harmed — only corporate/industrial facility disclosures required by federal law.

false_positives_clarified.pii_check_phone_flag: The validation script flagged 23 facility names containing 10-digit TRI facility IDs in parentheses (e.g., '(0145000399)') as potential phone numbers. These are EPA-issued facility identifiers, not actual phone numbers. No personal or facility contact phone numbers exist in this dataset.

recommendation: APPROVED FOR PRODUCT CREATION.
